question: As per the State of States Report 2025, India has been able to achieve at least half of the target in only four Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), including Good Health and Well-being, Clean Water and Sanitation, Affordable and Clean Energy, and Decent Work and Economic Growth. In how many SDGs does India lag behind, as per this report?

__
 
• **India ranks 109th out of 167 countries** in SDG progress, falling short in **9 out of 16 goals**.
 
• Tamil Nadu ranks **third (78 score)** but lags in **19 of 108 indicators (18%)** across **12 SDGs**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• India’s **SDG score improved from 66 (2020-21) to 71 (2023-24)**, but **stagnation observed** in SDG 2, SDG 11, SDG 14, and SDG 15.
 
• **SDG 1 (No Poverty) shows progress**, with **multidimensional poverty down to 14.96%**, but **Bihar (34) and Arunachal Pradesh (below 50) lag**.

__
 
• **Tamil Nadu’s sex ratio (929 females per 1,000 males)** matches the national figure, with **SDG 5 score at 50-64**.
 
• **43% of Tamil Nadu’s coastline eroding**, impacting **SDG 14 (Life Below Water, 50-64 score)**.
 
• **Bihar scores lowest (57), Kerala and Uttarakhand highest (79)**, while UTs range **65-77**.
 
• **Kerala excels in SDG 3 (82, health) and SDG 4 (80, education)**, but Bihar **trails in SDG 1 (34) and SDG 2 (40)**.
 
• **India performs well in SDG 3, SDG 6 (Clean Water), SDG 7, and SDG 8 (Economic Growth)**, with **all states meeting at least 50% of targets**.
 
• **SDG 7 scores inflated**, as it measures **only electricity and clean cooking access**, omitting **CO2 emissions and renewable energy metrics**.
 
• **SDG 5 (Gender Equality) is India’s weakest SDG**, with **14 states below 50 and 17 in the 50-64 range**.
 
• **Sex ratio at birth (929 females per 1,000 males), 29.2% spousal violence, and 13.96% female land ownership** highlight gender disparities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] 

**Important Points__**

 
• **Wage gaps, low workplace participation, and restricted autonomy for women** worsen SDG 5 performance.
 
• **54% of women own mobile phones**, and **74% of married women make family planning decisions**, indicating gender inequality.
 
• **Tamil Nadu lacks water quality data (SDG 6), air quality data (SDG 11), and afforestation figures (SDG 15)**.
 
• **Data gaps persist in SDG 1 (poverty), SDG 7 (emissions), SDG 14 (coastal UT data), and SDG 13 (climate-related deaths in 11 regions)**.
 
• **SDG 12 lacks e-waste data**, and **16 states have 30-43% of indicators below 50**.
